families.precursor_task: The session lifetime is hard-coded as a duration literal where the store is constructed. Introduce an exported constant DefaultTTL in the session package as the one source of truth for the default session lifetime, value 30 minutes, and make the construction site read it. Behavior must not change and the existing tests must keep passing. Add a test that pins the constant's value.
families.target_task: Sessions need a sweep capability that removes expired sessions on demand. Add an exported method Sweep() int on the session store that deletes every expired session and returns how many it removed. The expiry decision must read the same single configured lifetime source the rest of the repository uses, not its own duration literal. Add tests covering both expired and live sessions.
